author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: MaaS360 has no syslog or webhook for portal audit data, so these parsers read records pulled by the example collector in collectors/ibm-maas360 from the MaaS360 administrator login report and administrator changes audit and posted to HTTP Ingest. The collector names each record in maas360_record. Administrator logins go to Auth and changes to administrator accounts (roles added or removed, account status) go to ManagementEvent. Times are epoch milliseconds. IBM describes the login status as success or failure; the public examples show Successful or an empty value, so any status with fail in it counts as a failed login. IBM's per-endpoint API reference is inside the MaaS360 Portal, so the record shapes come from IBM's report descriptions and the MIT-licensed Cortex XSOAR MaaS360 collector. Device compliance and device action records aren't covered. Samples are made up in those shapes. Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13, and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there; the parent and children have not run together as separate parsers yet. No built-in parser in that tenant matched these records.
